aside.title: A simple pot
aside.copy: Money that’s decided to wait. £50 a month moves itself — no target, no deadline, withdraw whenever. If it’s still undecided in autumn, I’ll ask again, gently.

goal.title: A goal pot
goal.copy: A pot with a ring around it: £1,000, fed £100 a month, reached in ten months. Name it what you like — change the target or the date any time, both free.

grow.title: An investment pot
grow.copy: Start with £150 a month towards a long-term investment plan. Explore the projection and adjust the amount before you decide.

together.title: A shared pot
together.copy: One pot, several people, receipts for everyone. You choose who’s in; each person’s own money stays their own. Invites go out when you’re ready.
